name: Seed Junky Pre-Roll | Bubblegum Sherb
description: Bubble Gum Sherb is a classic hybrid made by crossing Indiana Bubble Gum with Sherb. Marked by sweet and fruity flavors, this functional strain will have you in cruise control all day long.
